name: Tsukuyomi
source:
A mysterious man who lives in Naraku, the lowest level of Yomi.
He makes prosthetic limbs for those who have lost body parts due to Haku, moreover he's drawing a giant mandala using Shou as paint.
He is also the protector of the White on Tennyo Island and [url=/c74512]Olympia[/url] thinks of him as her only family.

[spoiler] In "Catharsis" he spends his days peacefully painting, as with the completion of a cure for Haku, requests for his prosthetic limbs have decreased. He refuses to get involved with white-haired [url=/c156287]Nathanael[/url].
